name: SPE2 axisymmetric three-phase coning candidate
physics_regime: Candidate finite-deformation solid-reference four-phase mixture realization of SPE2, with one deformable matrix phase and water, oil, and gas fluid phases on the published radial-vertical geometry.

manuscript_basis.role: Conserve stock-tank water, oil, and gas with the published PVTW, PVTO, and PVDG data.
Solve solid constituent storage, finite-deformation axisymmetric skeleton kinematics and momentum, and the pulled-back component fluxes.
assumptions_added: The paper supplies rock compressibility but no shear response; any shear modulus used by the candidate must be reported as an untuned mechanical specialization.
The external mechanical support and reference prestress are benchmark modeling choices and must be reported.

manuscript_basis.role: Use anisotropic layer permeability, gravity, Stone-II mobility, and the stored-capillary/electrical/saturation-force phase-pressure identity.
assumptions_added: The official electrical specialization is neutral.
SPE2 supplies no dynamic-capillary resistance, so the official saturation Onsager matrix is zero.

manuscript_basis.role: Retain tau, dissolved/free-gas chemical potentials, gas phase conversion, transfer work, and nonnegative conversion dissipation.

variables.name: ux uy
variables.meaning: Radial and axial Q2 continuous-Galerkin displacement of the deformable solid skeleton.

variables.name: water_saturation water_saturation_enrichment
variables.meaning: P2+P0 reconstructed physical water saturation with entropy-viscosity stabilization.

variables.name: gas_saturation gas_saturation_enrichment
variables.meaning: P2+P0 reconstructed physical gas saturation with entropy-viscosity stabilization.

variables.name: solution_gas_oil_ratio
variables.meaning: Continuous parent solution-gas ratio consumed by the black-oil phase closure.

variables.name: water_oil_pressure_difference gas_oil_pressure_difference
variables.meaning: P2 projections of the water/oil and gas/oil stored, electrical, and dissipative pressure identities.

variables.name: fluid_temperature solid_temperature
variables.meaning: Two solved temperature fields retaining the complete energy hierarchy in the official isothermal specialization.

variables.name: matrix_reference_component_storage
variables.meaning: Layer-discontinuous solid constituent storage on the reference configuration.

closures.name: spe2_phase_transforming_darcy_flux
outputs: finite-deformation water, oil, and gas reference relative mass fluxes

mesh.description: Exact 10 by 15 radial-vertical SPE2 topology represented by 150 QUAD9 elements in RZ coordinates, spanning 0.25 to 2050 ft radius and 9000 to 9359 ft depth, with completion blocks 107 and 108.

boundary_conditions: No-flow component and thermal flux on all external reservoir boundaries.
Axisymmetric radial and axial mechanics with minimal rigid-body support and explicitly reported external traction assumptions.
Internal producer completions in radial cell 1, layers 7 and 8, under scheduled oil-rate control until the 3000 psia datum-BHP limit activates.
initial_conditions: Oil pressure is 3600 psia at the 9035 ft gas-oil contact.
The water-oil contact is 9209 ft and the gas-oil contact is 9035 ft, with the tabulated capillary-pressure functions.
Initial phase state is hydrostatic and capillary-equilibrated from the published contacts and PVT tables.
Initial displacement is zero and subsequent J is solved.
Fluid and solid temperatures start at one common reported isothermal datum.

execution.type: Candidate fully coupled transient finite-deformation solid-reference Newton solve
execution.solver_notes: Exercise Q2 axisymmetric mechanics, P1+P0 pressure and tau, P2+P0 saturations, explicit phase-pressure closure rows, DG facet and weak-boundary operators, active phase conversion, two energy equations, two-completion AD rate aggregation, and rate/BHP complementarity. A solve=false, fixed-skeleton, finite-volume, or cached-output path cannot satisfy any coupled gate.

outputs: Initial oil, water, and gas in place
Oil rate, water cut, GOR, datum BHP, and layer-7 drawdown histories
Phase-volume, saturation, J, mechanics, tau/mu, dissipation, and two-temperature energy diagnostics
Pressure and saturation field snapshots plus nonlinear/timestep performance metrics

validation.pass_fail: All candidate static and coupled gates in validation/reference_data/spe2_candidate_gates.yml pass. This is promotion-quality candidate evidence only; production acceptance additionally requires verified registry blocks, a protected assembly manifest, the full 900-day run, and convergence/reference-comparison evidence.

open_questions: All eleven SPE2 reusable fragments remain candidate blocks and therefore cannot enter a production deck assembled from protected verified payloads.
The primary paper does not prescribe a solid shear response, mechanical boundary tractions, or caloric parameters; the candidate must record and test each specialization.
A hydrostatic/capillary initialization solve and its initial-fluids-in-place comparison remain required before advancing the 900-day schedule.
